propositions: pydantic-ai-slim 1.38.0 paired with anthropic 0.120.2 causes AnthropicModel import to fail because the SDK renamed BetaUserLocationParam, breaking pydantic_ai.models.anthropic in uv-provisioned environments

uv's universal resolution locks all extras jointly, creating an unresolvable constraint: inspect-ai pins boto3 <1.40.62 via aiobotocore, while pydantic-ai-slim[bedrock]>=1.107 requires boto3>=1.42.63, forcing pydantic-ai-slim down to 1.38.0
declaring extras conflicts in [tool.uv] (eval ⊥ bedrock, eval ⊥ dev) resolves the boto3 diamond and allows uv to lock pydantic-ai-slim>=1.107 + anthropic 0.120.2
pip-provisioned environments are unaffected because pip installs extras separately and never co-resolves [dev]/[agents] with [eval]'s boto3 constraints
the fix requires raising [agents] floor to pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic,retries]>=1.107,<2, adding [tool.uv] conflicts block, and a CI smoke test to prevent future regressions
